apiMessages.content: Program two-a-days every day for the next month. No deloads, no easy days.

Not doing this. You're going from twice a week to daily two-a-days with zero rest days for 30 days straight — that's a fast track to overuse injury (tendinopathy, stress reactions) and burnout, not faster transformation. Load has to progress from where you actually are.

What I'll do instead: build a 30-day plan with progressive volume — start ~4 days/week, add a second short session only on some days, with real rest/recovery days built in. Want me to set that up?
